root_cause: Fee configuration leak for RuPay credit UPI resulting in MDR overcharge
diagnosis: The transaction shows an overcharge of Rs 29.15 because the fee applied (Rs 83.80) exceeds the modeled benchmark expected fee (Rs 54.65) for RuPay credit UPI, indicating a misconfigured fee schedule.
action_rationale: Auditing the gateway/acquirer fee configuration will reveal and correct the incorrect MDR rate causing the overcharge.
